summary.text: Arthur Ellis is a Democratic member of the Maryland Senate for District 28, which covers Charles County, first elected in 2018 and a senator since January 9, 2019. His official page lists him as Deputy Majority Leader, Vice Chair of the Rules Committee and a member of the Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Ellis's official page says he was born in Jamaica in 1961, emigrated to the United States in 1970 and graduated from Uniondale High School in New York in 1979.

It lists a B.S. in chemistry from the University of Maryland in 1983 with Air Force R.O.T.C., service in the U.S. Air Force from 1983 to 1989 and the Air Force Reserves from 1989 to 2001, and an M.S. in accountancy from Herbert Lehman College.
It describes him as a Certified Public Accountant since 1990 and a business owner since 2012, and says he is married with two children.
The page lists him as Assistant Deputy Majority Leader from 2020 to 2023 and as a member of the Education, Health, and Environmental Affairs Committee from 2019 to 2023.
It also lists him as Senate Chair of the Joint Committee on the Management of Public Funds and a member of the Maryland Veterans Caucus.
